rv.q: "Directed by Daniel Sullivan, who has a gift for raising dialogue to its smartest expression, 'If I Forget' is ambitious and often very funny...Although some of Levenson’s plot twists are contrived, the play is fearless in its confrontation of Jewish self-image before a New York audience that surely includes many Jews...He gives us a lot to...
If I Forget succeeds both as a thoughtful family drama filled with wit and as a compelling dissection of the world we live in.
